description: This file defines the interface for plugins within the WPEFramework, including plugin lifecycle management, communication, security, and notification mechanisms. It declares the IPlugin interface and related nested interfaces for plugin notifications, lifecycle, web communication, WebSocket, text socket, channel, security, and authentication.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin interface providing lifecycle methods (Initialize, Deinitialize, Information) and nested notification and lifetime interfaces.

classes.name: IPlugin::INotification
classes.description: Interface for plugin state change notifications (Activated, Deactivated, Unavailable).

classes.name: IPlugin::ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for plugin lifetime management (Initialize, Deinitialized).

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extended plugin interface supporting WebSocket channel attachment and detachment.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins with registration and unregistration of notifications.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for plugin activation and deactivation events.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for web request processing and inbound data handling.

classes.name: IWebSocket
classes.description: Interface for WebSocket communication, handling inbound messages and responses.

classes.name: ITextSocket
classes.description: Interface for text socket communication, handling inbound messages.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication, handling inbound and outbound data.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security checks on WebSocket upgrades, requests, and JSONRPC messages, and token management.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for token creation and security officer retrieval based on tokens.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Called when a plugin changes state to active.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Called when a plugin changes state to inactive.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Called when a plugin becomes unavailable.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a communication channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a communication channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification with the plugin.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification from the plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound Web request or WebSocket message.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a Web request and returns a response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound WebSocket message with identifier.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound WebSocket message with ID and JSON element.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound text socket message.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound raw data on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Sends raw data over a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket upgrade or request is allowed.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Retrieves the security token payload.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a security token from a buffer.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Retrieves the security officer interface for a given token.
